# Ockham

*1287 – 1347 · English · [Scholasticism](../movements/scholasticism.md)*

English Franciscan and logician, a major figure of [nominalism](../glossary/nominalism.md): he admits only individuals, gives primacy to divine omnipotence and lent his name to the principle of parsimony, "Ockham's razor".
